title: MEMENTO: Learning Context Management for Long Context Processing Agents
abstract: arXiv:2611.00244v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: LLM agents that operate over long inputs must perform context management: deciding what to retain in a fixed-size context window. A common approach is compaction, where the model replaces its history with a self-generated note. Yet off-the-shelf agentic models, including GPT-5.5 and GLM-5.3, often write ineffective notes, and reinforcement learning (RL) alone rarely discovers useful note-taking behavior. We present MEMENTO, a long-context agent built on Qwen3-8B and trained to manage its context through compaction. We first bootstrap note-taking by fine-tuning on synthetic trajectories annotated with notes generated in hindsight, then reinforce it with RL using a reward that combines answer correctness, note-quality heuristics, and confidence calibration. Although trained only to compact into a fresh window, MEMENTO extends at test time to strategies such as context folding and confidence-based backtracking. On book-level question answer

translated_title: MEMENTO：面向长上下文处理智能体的上下文管理学习
translated_abstract: 在长输入上运行的LLM智能体必须执行上下文管理，即决定在固定大小的上下文窗口中保留哪些内容。一种常见方法是压缩，即模型用自生成的笔记替换其历史记录。然而，现成的智能体模型，包括GPT-5.5和GLM-5.3，往往写出无效的笔记，而仅靠强化学习（RL）也很难发现有用的记笔记行为。我们提出了MEMENTO，这是一个基于Qwen3-8B构建、经训练学会通过压缩来管理上下文的长上下文智能体。我们首先通过在标注有事后生成的笔记的合成轨迹上进行微调来引导记笔记行为，然后使用结合答案正确性、笔记质量启发式指标和置信度校准的奖励进行强化学习。尽管MEMENTO仅被训练用于压缩到全新窗口中，但它在测试时能够扩展到上下文折叠和基于置信度的回溯等策略。在书籍级别的问答任务上……
tldr: 提出MEMENTO智能体，通过“事后笔记标注的合成轨迹微调+结合答案正确性、笔记质量与置信度校准的多目标奖励强化学习”两阶段训练，让Qwen3-8B学会有效的上下文压缩记笔记行为，并能泛化到上下文折叠和置信度回溯等测试时策略。
en_tdlr: MEMENTO is a long-context agent built on Qwen3-8B that learns effective context compaction through a two-stage approach—fine-tuning on synthetic trajectories annotated with hindsight notes, followed by RL with rewards combining answer correctness, note-quality heuristics, and confidence calibration—and generalizes at test time to strategies like context folding and confidence-based backtracking.
